name: fi-subdivision scheme
definition: A subdivision scheme for quadrilaterals (n=2) and arbitrary dimension n that inserts centroids and adjusts connectivity. It is analogous to Kobbelt's subdivision for triangles. In 4D, it generalizes hexadectree refinement, where one 1/2-subdivision step produces the same topological result as one hexadectree refinement step.
summary: The fi-subdivision scheme is a hierarchical data organization that doubles vertex counts per step, offering higher efficiency than octrees for multiresolution volume rendering.
